How it works

The app uses Bluetooth to control a Bluetooth compatible device.

How to connect

On the device you want to control, go to Bluetooth settings and try to connect to the Android device. You should see a dialog or notification on the Android device where you have to enter or confirm a PIN that is shown on the remote device.

What is the difference between the normal and the compatibility connection mode?

The normal connection mode is supported by most devices with Android 9 and above. This mode works with most Bluetooth devices that support a normal Bluetooth Keyboard or Mouse.

The compatibility connection mode is used by Android versions that do not support the normal connection mode. This mode uses Bluetooth 4.0 (Low Energy) which is only supported on newer devices. In this mode the connection may not work after the devices have been disconnected and the devices have to be paired again.

The characters I receive on my device are wrong

If the wrong letters appear, it means that the keyboard language is not set correctly on the connected device. To fix this, change the keyboard settings on the connected device to the same layout that is configured in the app. For connected Android devices, you also need to change the hardware keyboard language in the settings.

How do I connect to my Windows PC?

If the Windows device can't find the Android device, it may already be connected. To fix this, you need to remove the existing connection on your Windows device. If you use the Windows "Your Phone" Phone Link app, you have to disable the Windows Phone Link app on your phone and your PC. Then, you need to remove the Bluetooth pairing with your phone and connect again through the app connection screen.

Why does the Android app on the connected device restart after connecting or disconnecting?

Some Android apps have a problem when a Bluetooth keyboard or media remote is connected or disconnected.

The solution for this is to connect before using the app and close the app with the home button instead of the back button to keep the app connected to the device.

If you send me the name of the apps, I can try to contact the developers to fix this problem with the app.

Can I use the premium version on another device?

Yes, this is possible. The purchase is tied to the Google account. Please make sure that you are using the same account that you used for the purchase. Also restarting the device can solve problems with the payments.

How can I get a refund?

You can request a refund directly from Google: https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/2479637?hl=en or send me a mail.
